basic_profile.bio: An avid Android enthusiast from Toronto, Canada, who spends his evenings exploring tech forums and tinkering with devices. By day, I work as a junior IT technician, and by night, I delve into the world of custom ROMs and rooting. My interests include strategy gaming, specifically Endless Space, and learning new languages using Duolingo. I'm single and enjoy my solitude, but I often engage in casual discussions online. My typical online hours are from 6 PM to midnight, Eastern Time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a diploma in Information Technology and have spent the last few years self-teaching myself about Android rooting and custom ROMs. My interest began when I successfully rooted my first smartphone, and from there, it became a hobby. I frequently visit forums and subreddits to expand my knowledge.
